title: Unit two-sphere geodesic reference model
purpose: Provide a domain-neutral differential-geometric fixture for testing model contracts, numerical invariants, experiments, and exact mathematical-art provenance.

mathematical_structure.metric: Riemannian metric induced by the Euclidean inner product

maps.name: exp_map
maps.domain: {(p,v) : p in S^2, v in T_p S^2}
maps.singularities: No geometric singularity; the zero norm uses its analytic limit.

maps.name: log_map
maps.definition: Log_p(q) = theta(q - cp)/s, c = clip(p^T q,-1,1), s = ||q-cp||, theta = atan2(s,c)
maps.singularities: The principal direction is non-unique at q = -p.

parameters.meaning: Sphere radius fixed by the reference model

assumptions.statement: Inputs are finite and normalized to S^2.
The fixture has no selected application semantics.

invariants.statement: Every returned point has Euclidean norm one.
Logarithm vectors are tangent at their base point.
Geodesic distance is symmetric and nonnegative.
Exp_p(Log_p(q)) equals q away from the cut locus within tolerance.

uncertainty.representation: Deterministic analytic fixture with bounded floating-point residual; no stochastic uncertainty model.

limitations: The principal logarithm is not unique at the antipode.
The fixture does not represent sustainability, resilience, infrastructure, ecology, or human outcomes.
Internal mathematical verification is not external application validation.
